question: Which of three fixed relational invariants distinguishes the known H7+N1+Q1 residual pair, and what are their complete partitions on the existing stress corpus?
known_before_evaluation: The matrices and original H7/N1/Q1 outcomes are already public and have been inspected.
The corpus contains 207 representatives of 352 fixed draws; 6849 same-size pairs; 25 H7+N1 collisions, 24 resolved by Q1.
m8-r012 and m8-r070 are nonisomorphic, including after time reversal, but have equal H7, N1 and Q1.
All orders are cubic regular height-two orders. Directed vertex color refinement initialized by degrees remains constant on each layer at every round.
The three new invariant outputs have not been computed before this contract. Their selection is motivated by known outcomes, not blind validation.

input.selection: Every original representative, in original order. No new draws, filtering, adaptive additions or removal of failures.

invariants.I2: Ordered pair of multisets: common-successor counts for every unordered pair of lower vertices; common-predecessor counts for every unordered pair of upper vertices. Keep all zero counts and multiplicities.
invariants.I3: Ordered pair of multisets over all unordered triples in the lower/upper layer. Each entry is [the three sorted pairwise common-neighbor counts, the triple common-neighbor count], flattened to four integers. Future and past components remain ordered; include zeros and multiplicities.
invariants.R2: Directed ordered-pair Weisfeiler-Leman refinement. c0(u,v) is (pred(u),succ(u),pred(v),succ(v),[u=v],Cuv,Cvu). c(t+1)(u,v) is the exact tuple (c(t)(u,v), sorted multiset over w of the ORDERED pair (c(t)(u,w),c(t)(w,v))). Colors are compressed by sorted exact tuples jointly over all graphs of the SAME n, never independently per graph. Preserve multiplicities; no hash is used for feature equality. Stop when the global number of colors stops increasing; output the per-graph stable color histogram. Store every round's color matrices. Color IDs are contextual to this jointly refined corpus, not portable standalone fingerprints.
invariants.R1_control: Three diagnostic rounds of directed vertex refinement initialized by predecessor/successor degrees; its all-round failure on the family is proved by induction, not inferred from three rounds.

endpoints: For the known target pair: full I2 and I3 values, exact differing entries if any, R2 first distinguishing round and stable partition; preserve unresolved outcomes.
For each size and each of I2, I3, R2, H7+N1+I2, H7+N1+I3, H7+N1+R2 and H7+N1+Q1 plus each new invariant: all class counts, unresolved pairs and residual groups.
Report complete same-size pair counts and target outcome separately. No population probability, p-value, held-out performance or general reconstruction claim.

Record integer payloads, zero characteristic-polynomial calls for the three new features, logical intersection counts, R2 refinement rounds and n^3 contributions per graph per round. R2 color dictionary context and round traces are additional shared storage; histogram payload alone is not standalone storage cost.
One-run feature timings are descriptive only; do not compare them as a controlled speed benchmark against historical Q1 timings.
Fixed panel only: if all three fail, archive the failure without extending the panel. A new independent challenge requires a separate later contract.
verification: Producer I2/I3 uses bitset intersections; checker counts explicit Boolean incidences over all candidate neighbors.

Producer R2 enumerates intermediate vertices; checker counts intersections of outgoing and incoming color-class sets. Compare every exact color matrix at every round, all features and complete summaries.
Reverse the labels of every input and check transport of every R2 color matrix and equality of every I2/I3 value. The reference uses full directed relations.
Recheck H7/N1/Q1 equality of the target with both existing exact arithmetic paths, and its nonisomorphism and nonduality with both existing exact isomorphism solvers.

Reject a self-loop, altered feature, lost multiplicity, omitted representative, corrupted R2 trace and omitted residual summary. Toy tests (n<=4) must distinguish joint ordered color-pair information from separated marginal multisets.
No external human review is implied by two implementations from the same authoring process.
freeze_policy: Commit this known-data diagnostic contract before evaluating new features. Freeze and hash all execution sources and input before target evaluation; bind to actual Git commit IDs. Record the actual publication chronology without claiming blinded or independent preregistration. Corrections after first target evaluation require an explicit deviation record and fresh run.

decisions.PASS_EXACT_DIAGNOSIS: Complete fixed corpus, source binding, exact countercheck and negative controls passed. This status does not imply target separation.
decisions.INCONCLUSIVE: Incomplete computation, timeout, nonstabilization, source mismatch or failed check.

limits: No novelty claim for Weisfeiler-Leman or intersection invariants
No global minimality of a separating feature
No general equivalence or domination between I3, R2 and Q1
No physical spacetime, quantum dynamics or continuum-limit evidence
